svg.title: Two reducers for a messages list that holds a human message with id 1 and an AI message with id 2. A node returns an edited AI message that reuses id 2. With operator.add it is appended, so the list ends with both the old and the edited copy. With add_messages the message with id 2 is replaced, so the list keeps one copy, the edited one. A message with a new id is appended by both.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The list holds Human (id 1) and AI (id 2). A node returns an edited AI message that reuses id 2.
